entries.author: OECUMENIUS TRICCAE IN THESSALIA EPISCOPUS
entries.title: Commentaria in Epistolas Pauli
entries.note: Elenchus prints no column for this item (OCR shows only a stray '19' at line 275); column from body, matches the volume's closing Ordo rerum. Body head 'NARRATIO DE DIVO PAULO APOSTOLO' (Greek head at line 21925) on page 307|308, with Euthalii Prologus, Peregrinatio and Martyrium Pauli (cols 307-315) before the Argumentum ad Romanos (col 318); Ordo lists 'COMMENTARIUM IN EPISTOLAS PAULI' above Narratio 307. In this volume the Pauline commentary runs Romans-Galatians (to col ~1330 end; Galatians commentary from col 1021 per Ordo).

entries.author: OECUMENIUS TRICCAE IN THESSALIA EPISCOPUS
entries.title: Commentaria in Epistolas Catholicas
entries.note: Elenchus lists it but prints no column. No head in this volume: searched 'CATHOLIC' (only passing mentions at lines 392, 583, 65845) and the Ordo rerum, which ends at Galatians (col 1021+). Volume stops at col 1330, so this work is evidently in a later tome (check 119/120). Settled by PG 119: its Ordo lists the Catholic Epistles commentary (Jacobi col 451 onward), so the work continues in 119.

problems: Elenchus has no readable column numbers at all (only a stray '19'); every column is from the body, cross-checked with the Ordo rerum, status 'body-only'.
Page numbers are lost in the front matter before col 13, so cols 9 and 11 for Notitia/Donati/Hentenii are inferred from Ordo plus the surviving running head '12' (line 357).
Elenchus promises Commentaria in Epistolas Catholicas but the volume (cols 1-1330) holds Acts and Pauline epistles only through at least Galatians; Catholicas not present.
Pauline commentary one Elenchus entry; the Ordo lists separate Romans, 1 Cor, 2 Cor, Galatians commentaries, not split here since the Elenchus doesn't.
